THE DETAILS

What happens after you apply?

We review your account details, confirm whether we can take the case and send a quote. Once the scope is agreed, we start the work and keep you updated. Estimated turnaround is 3–14 days from acceptance; timing and outcomes depend on the case.

BEFORE YOU START

Good to know.

Some disabled accounts can be recovered. The account history and reason for the restriction matter, so we assess the case first.

Your account link or username, the restriction message and when access was lost. Never include passwords or login codes.

No. We confirm the available route before accepting the case, but the final account decision remains with the platform.
